title: PhysDial: Adapting Pretrained Video Models for PDE Simulation under Changing Physical Conditions
abstract: arXiv:2611.23498v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Simulating how physical systems respond to changing conditions is central to control, design, and scenario studies. To our knowledge, prior PDE foundation models have not been trained or evaluated on changes within trajectories. Our counterfactual test measures how far predictions move toward a changed solver branch from the same state. Models trained on fixed conditions follow changes only partly. A PDE foundation model given a condition input after pretraining barely responds. PhysDial adapts a pretrained video diffusion transformer to eight two-dimensional PDE families. Coefficients enter with the noise level, condition fields as reference frames, and equation text as a prompt. In Kolmogorov flow, switches within trajectories account for about 5% of the training samples. At matched compute, they halve the error after a change in forcing wavenumber or amplitude. A few trajectories at new amplitudes more than halve extrapolation error

translated_title: PhysDial：在物理条件变化下适配预训练视频模型进行偏微分方程仿真
translated_abstract: 模拟物理系统如何响应变化的条件，对于控制、设计和场景研究至关重要。据我们所知，先前的偏微分方程（PDE）基础模型尚未在轨迹内部的条件变化上进行过训练或评估。我们的反事实测试衡量在相同初始状态下，模型预测向改变后的求解器分支偏移的程度。在固定条件下训练的模型只能部分跟随这些变化；而一个仅在预训练后接收条件输入的PDE基础模型几乎不作响应。PhysDial将预训练的视频扩散Transformer适配到八个二维PDE家族：系数随噪声水平一起输入，条件场作为参考帧，方程文本作为提示。在Kolmogorov流中，轨迹内部的切换仅占训练样本的约5%。在相同计算量下，这些方法在强迫波数或振幅发生变化后能将误差减半；仅用少量新振幅下的轨迹，就能将外推误差减少一半以上。
tldr: PhysDial通过将预训练视频扩散Transformer适配到八个二维PDE家族，仅用约5%的轨迹内条件切换训练样本，就能在物理条件变化后将预测误差减半，大幅提升了PDE仿真模型对动态条件变化的响应能力。
en_tdlr: PhysDial adapts a pretrained video diffusion transformer to eight 2D PDE families, and with only ~5% of training samples containing within-trajectory condition switches, it halves prediction error after changes in physical conditions such as forcing wavenumber or amplitude.
